evidence: testssl.sh confirms the server only offers TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3 — SSLv2, SSLv3, TLS 1.0, and TLS 1.1 are all NOT offered. No weak ciphers detected: no RC4, no DES, no NULL, no EXPORT ciphers. The server is not vulnerable to POODLE, BEAST, CRIME, FREAK, DROWN, SWEET32, Heartbleed, or any other tested TLS vulnerability. The original scanner evidence only contained informational certificate details with no actual weak cipher/protocol findings.
